mandatory_gates_in_order: The event is CHANGED, every supported visible field is resolved and unchanged except muted_badge true to false, and the joint-state alternatives are unchanged.
Previous and current primary_frequency are the same single canonical DD.DDD value.
The candidate is one maximal nonempty primary_frequency ambiguous run with exact reason inconsistent illuminated frequency segment levels; unreadable and other ambiguity reasons are never redraws.
Only the contiguous subset product-unresolved solely in primary_frequency is claimed; other full-run frames remain support and cannot be excused.
Two immediate same-value readable frequency supports precede and follow the full field run.
Video and source indices are consecutive, every gap is within the verified maximum of 10 ms, and the full support chain spans at most 50 ms.
Every chain frame has the exact expected five canonical masks, no partial segment, every expected-off segment off, both holes per digit at or below 0.10 ink fraction, and a clearly on decimal.
Every expected-on segment endpoint median rises by at least 50 intensity levels.

Every lit-segment component stays within normalized progress -0.10 through 1.10, has no backward step over 0.10, and has no more than 0.15 total backward motion; components may advance asynchronously.
The record affects primary_frequency only, changes no raw observation, and is usable only through an exact product-policy allowlist entry.

scope.claim: A maximal raw same-frequency refusal is a coherent captured gray-to-bright illumination sweep during unmute.
does_not_claim: a value for any ambiguous frame

validation.observer_eligibility_rule: COHERENT_STABLE_FREQUENCY_ILLUMINATION_SWEEP with BOTH_CLEAR endpoints, SAME_GLYPHS, and HIGH confidence
